data.name: Ancalin
data.long_meaning: Ancalin is derived from Ancalia, the name of a Greek goddess. She was the protector of cities and fortresses, offering refuge and safety to those in need. Ancalin is a spiritual name, symbolizing a strong, unwavering faith and a deep commitment to providing shelter and security to those around us.
